newsitem.title: UK: LME aluminium tumbles to 2-1/4 year low.
newsitem.headline: LME aluminium tumbles to 2-1/4 year low.

text.p: The price of three months aluminium on the London Metal Exchange (LME) fell to $1,392 per tonne on Monday, the lowest price seen for over 2-1/4 years.
The losses took the price below the key $1,400 level and came on a day where bearish sentiment again swamped the base metals complex.
Traders said rising production and LME stocks, as well as slow physical offtake worldwide were helping to push the market steadily lower.
Trade buying emerged earlier on Monday, but consumers appeared to back off as downward momentum gathered pace.
The drop below $1,400 leaves the market vulnerable to a test of next support at $1,330, chartists said.
On the upside, first resistance was pegged at $1,400 then $1,440.
